description: Internal rate of return for evenly spaced yearly cash flows after an initial investment. Use xirr instead when cash flows have specific dates or irregular timing. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/irr-calculator

cash_flows_usd.description: Net cash flow for each following year, in order (year 1, year 2, ...). Positive = money received, negative = more money invested.

items.description: Net cash flow for the year in USD.

initial_investment_usd.description: Amount invested at the start (year 0), as a positive number.
